note: Demo submodule of extra_field_plus. Provides two @ExtraFieldDisplay plugins for node.* (visible:false): example_node_label (ExampleNodeLabel extends ExtraFieldPlusDisplayBase) and example_node_label_formatted (ExampleNodeLabelFormatted extends ExtraFieldPlusDisplayFormattedBase). Both expose settings link_to_entity (checkbox) and wrapper (select span/p/h1-h5, default span). On the display they become components extra_field_example_node_label / extra_field_example_node_label_formatted; settings live in that component's settings and are validated by config schema field.formatter.settings.extra_field_example_node_label[_formatted]. Medium/hard cases are grounded in the real entity_view_display component settings on node.article.default. Setup/reset scripts enable this module.

evals.prompt: What extra field display plugins does the extra_field_plus_example module provide (give their ids)?
evals.expected_output: Two: example_node_label (ExampleNodeLabel, raw base) and example_node_label_formatted (ExampleNodeLabelFormatted, formatted base). Both render the node label with a suffix, for node.* bundles.

evals.prompt: What display settings do the extra_field_plus_example plugins expose, and what is the default wrapper?
evals.expected_output: Two settings: link_to_entity (checkbox — wrap the label in a link to the node) and wrapper (select of span/p/h1-h5). The default wrapper is 'span' and link_to_entity defaults to false.

evals.prompt: After enabling extra_field_plus_example, where do I go to see and configure its example extra fields?
evals.expected_output: On a node bundle's Manage display page (e.g. /admin/structure/types/manage/article/display) the two example extra fields appear (in the Disabled region because visible:false); drag them out and click the cog to set link_to_entity and wrapper.

evals.prompt: On this site, the Example Node Label extra field is placed on the Article default display. Inspect the live display configuration and report its configured wrapper HTML tag.
evals.expected_output: The wrapper is 'h4' (component extra_field_example_node_label settings.wrapper in core.entity_view_display.node.article.default).

evals.prompt: On this site the Example Node Label Formatted extra field is on the Article default display. Inspect the configuration and state whether its link_to_entity setting is enabled.
evals.expected_output: Yes — link_to_entity is true for the component extra_field_example_node_label_formatted.

evals.prompt: With the extra_field_plus_example module enabled, place its 'Example Node Label' extra field onto the Article default view display (out of the Disabled region). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Add the component extra_field_example_node_label to core.entity_view_display.node.article.default in a visible (content) region and save.

evals.prompt: The Example Node Label extra field is placed on the Article default display with its wrapper set to span. Change its wrapper setting to h5 and apply the change to the live display configuration.
evals.expected_output: On core.entity_view_display.node.article.default set the extra_field_example_node_label component's settings.wrapper = 'h5' and save.
